value.rationale: At order sixteen the three nonisomorphic maximal-class 2-groups first coexist. Their group-algebra square-zero totals are computed simultaneously for every finite characteristic-two field, and their binary regular-differential ranks coincide below eight but separate at the acyclic rank. This natural representation-theoretic and homological boundary is not a known-table restatement or an arbitrary matrix slice.
